network_policies:

      - host: "192.0.2.10"

          - allow:
              method: "POST"
              path: "/llm/anthropic/v1/messages"

          provider: "reef-run-205c205c205c205c205c205c205c205c"

        enforcement: "enforce"
        request_body_credential_rewrite: false
        allow_uninspected_credentials: false
        mcp:
          versions:
            - "2025-03-26"
          strict_tool_names: true
        rules:
          - allow:
              method: "initialize"
          - allow:
              method: "notifications/initialized"
          - allow:
              method: "tools/list"
          - allow:
              method: "tools/call"
              tool:
                any:
                  - "proofs.list"
                  - "budget.get"
                  - "plan.get_state"
                  - "plan.update_task"
                  - "openbrain.report_usage"
                  - "openbrain.inspect_memory"

                  - "openbrain.review_memory"
                  - "openbrain.get_recall_trace"
                  - "openbrain.recall"
                  - "openbrain.writeback"
                  - "jira.get_issue"
                  - "jira.get_issue_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx"
        credential_binding:
          provider: "reef-run-205c205c205c205c205c205c205c205c"
    binaries:
      - path: "/usr/local/lib/node_modules/opencode-ai/bin/opencode.exe"
